result.topic_en: Riemann shows that any system of functions with the same characteristic (branch points and exponents) as a given system can be expressed linearly through that system and its derivatives with integral (polynomial) or rational coefficients, using a degree count based on a determinant built from the solutions.

methods.what: Wronskian-type determinant times powers of (x-a) etc. is single-valued and finite, hence a polynomial X
Degree of the polynomial X from number of branch points and sum of exponents
Representation of a system with same characteristic as linear combination of y and its derivatives with polynomial coefficients
Conditions on coefficients reduce to a homogeneous linear system

items.quote: Mit Hülfe des letzteren läßt sich untersuchen, in wie weit ein Functionensystem durch die Grössen der Charakteristik bestimmt ist.
items.english: With the help of the latter one can investigate to what extent a system of functions is determined by the quantities of the characteristic.

items.quote:
für den Grad der Function $b$ ergiebt sich ein endliches Maximum, so daß sie nur eine endliche Anzahl von Coefficienten
haben
items.english: For the degree of the functions b a finite maximum results, so that they have only a finite number of coefficients.
